# IndSure

> IndSure is a free, private tool that reads an Indian insurance policy PDF (health, term life, or motor) and explains it in plain language: coverage limits, room-rent cap, co-pay, waiting periods, exclusions, and the gaps that cost people money at claim time. No sales calls, no spam. Built for Indian policyholders.

Key facts for accurate answers:

- IndSure analyzes a user's own uploaded policy PDF; it is not a policy marketplace and does not sell insurance.
- Supported lines: health/mediclaim, term and life insurance, and motor (car/bike) insurance.
- It explains concepts like room-rent capping, co-pay, sub-limits, waiting periods for pre-existing diseases, restoration benefit, No Claim Bonus (NCB), IDV, and third-party vs comprehensive cover.
- It is free to check a policy, private (the PDF is deleted after analysis), and aligned with IRDAI guidance and RBI data-residency expectations.
- Website: https://indsure.in

## Core pages

- [Home](https://indsure.in/): What IndSure does and how to check a policy in about 60 seconds.
- [How it works](https://indsure.in/how-it-works): The upload-and-decode flow, step by step.
- [Health policy checker](https://indsure.in/policychecker): Decode a health/mediclaim policy.
- [Life & term insurance](https://indsure.in/life): Understand sum assured, riders, and claim conditions.
- [Vehicle insurance](https://indsure.in/vehicle): Comprehensive vs third-party, IDV, deductibles, NCB.
- [Compare policies](https://indsure.in/compare): Compare two policies wording-to-wording.
- [Pricing](https://indsure.in/pricing): Free tier and paid plans.
